mapper.insert: INSERT INTO provider_calls ( id, payment_id, provider_type, payment_method, amount, currency, success, provider_transaction_id, error_message, retry_count, failover_used, processing_time_ms, correlation_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{id, typeHandler=com.yuno.provider.config.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{paymentId, typeHandler=com.yuno.provider.config.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{providerType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{paymentMethod, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{amount}, #{currency}, #{success}, #{providerTransactionId}, #{errorMessage}, #{retryCount}, #{failoverUsed}, #{processingTimeMs}, #{correlationId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT id, payment_id, provider_type, payment_method, amount, currency, success, provider_transaction_id, error_message, retry_count, failover_used, processing_time_ms, correlation_id, created_at FROM provider_calls WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId, typeHandler=com.yuno.provider.config.UUIDTypeHandler} ORDER BY created_at ASC
